root_causes.title: Stale extension-version rehydration marker could suppress required page-context recovery after update
root_causes.resolution: Version-aware stale-marker recovery forces eligible-tab rehydration when the stored extension version differs from the current runtime version.

root_causes.title: Concurrent startup rehydration calls could duplicate page-context injection
root_causes.resolution: Per-runtime in-flight coalescing guarantees concurrent callers share one recovery run.

root_causes.title: Page-context recovery failures lacked bounded machine-readable diagnostics
root_causes.resolution: Recovery results and session markers now retain bounded generic diagnostic codes and failed tab IDs without storing URLs or raw exception text.

root_causes.title: Eligible page-context injections executed serially and caused startup latency to scale linearly with tab count
root_causes.resolution: Bounded deterministic concurrency of four injections preserves retry/failure semantics while reducing 12-tab synthetic recovery from an approximately 120 ms serial reference to low-30 ms p50/p95 measurements.

assurance_gaps_closed: content-script MAIN/ISOLATED world registration and duplicate-injection guards
workforce initialization, role catalog and company boundary startup contracts
broad Chrome-load regression, inherited-failure comparison and resource integrity
known_environment_limitations: The available Chromium build/policy blocks unpacked-extension loading, so real browser lifecycle certification remains environment-blocked rather than falsely passed.
